title: Count Prefixes of a Given String
summary: Given a list of words and a string s, count how many words in the list are prefixes of s.
statement: Given a list of words and a string s, count how many words in the list are prefixes of s. A prefix is a substring that starts at the beginning of s.
constraints: Count each word occurrence separately when it is a prefix of s.
A prefix must match from the first character and may equal the whole string.
All words and s are nonempty lowercase strings.
reference_solution:
def count_word_prefixes(words,s):
    return sum(s.startswith(word) for word in words)
hints: Test each word independently against the beginning of s.
Python startswith implements the required anchored substring comparison.
Sum s.startswith(word) for every word in the list.
Each true predicate contributes one for exactly one listed occurrence, including duplicates and whole-string matches.
editorial: Each true predicate contributes one for exactly one listed occurrence, including duplicates and whole-string matches.

tests.explanation: The prefixes a, ab, and abc match, so the count is three.
Both occurrences of a count independently, giving two.
